capabilities: Browse Monday.com boards and items in a sidebar panel
Embed board dashboards in notes via code blocks
Create linked notes from Monday items with task metadata
Create Monday items from selected text
Update item status, assignments, and comments from the sidebar
extras: Installation from Community Plugins is listed as 'Coming Soon'; manual installation from GitHub releases is currently required. README warns the API token is stored unencrypted in data.json and recommends not syncing it to public repositories.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or interact with Monday.com board data, so users must switch to the Monday.com app or browser to check and update tasks.
summary: Monday.com integration that views boards and items in a sidebar and notes, and creates, updates, and comments on Monday items from Obsidian.
